result:
All fourteen queries ran. I checked the answers for T1, T3, T4, T11, T12 and T13 by hand against the data, and they match. For T2, T5–T10 and T14 I only looked at the output.

T4's average is 33.17 over six users. T11's is 330.2 over five lines. T12's revenue is 204.91. In T13, Birch (109.97) and Acme (104.96) are the top two customers.

T3's and T10's results are maps, and they printed with different key styles. T3 printed string keys like `"US"`. T10 printed keywords like `:db`, because `--raw` mode shows keyword keys that way.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {:country null} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {:age null} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/labels * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {:login null} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | unionOf /0 /1 | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * (:r / | /0 | keyword | append "@" | append (r | /1))
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | at 2) * count
T11: lines * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first) | filter ~(ne null) * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"
